disposition: Preserved as rejected-contract evidence only; must not be executed or used to issue a Q1 terminal.
claim_ceiling: source-domain diagnostic falsifier; not complete FS/MRC, not satellite deployment, not novelty or METHOD_SIGNAL

waveform.receiver_lag_semantics: known-FSTS cross-polarization phase de-rotation; exact Wang Eq.8-11 at L_rx=B_L_tx

channel.stage_boundary: after ideal frame alignment, branch combining, and polarization demultiplexing
channel.fading_lifecycle: one quasi-static Gamma-Gamma intensity per 320-symbol FSTS
channel.snr_provenance: UNVERIFIED_DIAGNOSTIC_RANGE; not receiver optical power in dBm

splits.paired_contract: one immutable received X/Y FSTS per split/cell/seed; every lag consumes identical samples

baselines.B0: paper fixed receiver lag: qpsk=20, qam16=40
baselines.B1: dev-global fixed receiver lag per modulation
baselines.B2: dev-frozen lookup keyed by modulation,320,measured-power-bin; two median bins per modulation; unseen fallback B1
baselines.O1: test hidden-cell expected-best receiver lag; headroom/Kill only
baselines.O1_hindsight: per-realization best lag; diagnostic loose upper bound only
baselines.C1: forbidden until B2 residual, stability, observability, and actionability gates all pass

metrics.paired_ci: two-sided 95% Student-t CI over per-realization paired deltas

gates.stable_crossover: best-lag reversal across conditions with paired CI excluding zero on both sides
